releases.label: Preview 39
releases.title: Clearer services, library actions and compact tasks
highlights: Keep pastors in Team while hiding them from PC profiles; verified PC administrators see current connections.
Keep service schedule and notes open, place leadership beside Close, show first-slide previews and allow repeated songs in the running order.
Add library songs to services or request a separate group version or recoverable deletion on the updated PC app.
Open tasks from the entire card or comment count, use compact comments and attach images with remove and Undo.
Use matching team-role icons and a compact account save button.
Unsigned Windows preview; physical Windows, phone/iPad and ProPresenter 7.11 acceptance remain. Mac stays paused.

releases.label: Preview 38
releases.title: One workspace, compact songs and simpler planning
highlights: Prepare, Library and Services stay inside the main Windows window, with recoverable drafts and protected profile switching.
Browse compact song rows and actual slide previews; original and group versions remain separate across the website and computer.
Drag library songs into services and reorder them, with keyboard alternatives and reliable date/time editing.
Use collapsible task statuses, autosaved details, clear author identity and reversible deletion of tasks and comments.
Find clearer phone role controls and compact account/computer actions; only admins rename, and disconnecting removes only your own access.
Create new slides from any authenticated active Windows role; send typed lyrics or supported files from phones for operator review.
Clear completed upload history without deleting files or breaking receipts; keep PowerPoint conversion manual and linked-change attention concise.
Mac and the fourth output remain paused. This unsigned preview still needs physical Windows, phone/iPad and ProPresenter7.11 acceptance.

releases.label: Preview 37
releases.title: Church workflows and protected song updates
highlights: Review likely guitar chords before removing them, then apply selected changes or undo exactly.
Create named group copies without changing the generic song, and filter the shared library by group.
Protect incoming PC downloads with a 2 GiB reserve and keep low-space deliveries retryable.
Claim and finalize a service order; an approved worship member can explicitly take over for an absent leader.
Share chord-sheet images and PDFs across the approved ministry team, with authenticated viewing and deliberate removal.
Track feedback through New, In progress and Complete, with urgent flags and replies.
Enable an exact PowerPoint/ProPresenter pair for protected two-way lyric updates, with backups and warnings for missing or conflicting files.
Mac app development and the proposed fourth ProPresenter output remain on hold.

releases.label: Preview 36
releases.title: Editor repair and Windows background alerts
highlights: Fixes the blank editor after deleting or changing saved lyrics. The autosave timer now works in the real browser renderer, and reopening retains the draft.
A recovery screen can display and copy the saved draft after a display error, without rewriting the draft or library file.
Computers is first and opens by default. Page changes replace the previous song/service view; repeated tab switching is checked with real page components.
Windows alerts keep working while the app window is closed, at background startup, during Skip and while no profile is selected. Private details appear only with a current unlocked profile.
Notifications clear private details when identity changes, avoid replaying old file history and retain their twenty-minute expiry. Explicit Exit still closes the app.
A library with no shared snapshot says it is waiting for the computer’s first sync. Previously shared songs remain readable with the PC off.

releases.label: Preview 35
releases.title: Song library on the homepage
highlights: Accounts with song access now open the library on the website homepage. File sending stays in Computers.
A computer’s last shared lyrics remain readable while that PC is offline and outside service hours. The page shows the last sync and refreshes without losing searches or service edits.
The PC shares new conversions and saved songs promptly even without a selected service. Library includes a Sync phones control and sharing status.
Computers that finish loading after the page opens are selected correctly. A missing first sync is explained; songs must reach the cloud once before they can be read with the PC off.
If every library file is unreadable, the previous shared songs are preserved. A verified empty folder can still share an empty catalog.

releases.label: Preview 34
releases.title: Desktop connection repair and the Stați icon
highlights: The computer keeps its saved connection after startup and profile sign-in. Retrying pairing reuses the existing or unfinished connection instead of replacing it.
The phone code screen stays on phones and tablets. Desktop browsers sign in with a passkey, including when browser access was remembered.
Fixed-window attempt lockouts have been removed. Incorrect PINs and codes still fail; a correct PIN or code remains usable after repeated mistakes.
Bookmarks and iPhone Home Screen shortcuts use the supplied Stați logo. Existing shortcuts may need to be added again to refresh an older cached icon.

releases.label: Preview 33
releases.title: Shared songs, services and ministry roles
highlights: The identity prompt has a dark blurred backdrop and white account card. Skip for now stays hidden after leaving fullscreen.
Worship leaders can approve worship members and assign worship roles. Pastors can view songs and send files while editing stays restricted.
Approved worship teams and choir directors can browse a computer’s songs and arrange services from phones or the PC. Conversion and ProPresenter work stay on the PC.
Song search updates as you type, with list/grid first-slide previews. Services use numbered song cards, reordering and automatic saving with a Save fallback.
Existing lyric edits save into the same library file, preserving its title and presentation identity. Immediate refresh inside ProPresenter 7.11 still needs PC verification.
New playlists use date/time names. Retry and ordering changes protect existing playlists and manually added entries.
The Windows installer is about 147 MB, down from 192 MB. Its bundled OCR and PDF tools were checked offline.
Automatic cleanup for shared services is still being prepared; current services and playlists are kept.

releases.label: Preview 32
releases.title: Safer song conversion
highlights: Different songs that share an opening line are compared using their complete lyrics, so a song is not silently skipped.
Batch conversion checks saved output before resuming. Exports create the format you requested, including ProPresenter files.
Delayed PIN, phone unlock and profile selection responses cannot replace a newer profile choice.

releases.label: Preview 31
releases.title: Connection approvals and file status
highlights: PC connection approvals require the currently selected user. Switching users, cancelling an unlock, locking Windows or quitting clears that authority.
Received-file cards retain saved, rejected and expired status after temporary cloud records are cleaned up. Saved files keep their download and file actions.
Automatic administrator delivery checks the sender’s current role again. The profile picker also includes a way to check for app updates.

releases.label: Preview 30
releases.title: Services, lyrics and desktop updates
highlights: Service plans can queue local ProPresenter playlists and add songs saved for the selected service, with waiting and synced status.
Song search includes matching lyrics from later slides. The final Amen or Amin is slightly larger, italic and not bold.
The identity prompt follows service times, with Skip for now available from five minutes before service through its end.
Windows updates avoid creating desktop shortcuts and reduce desktop icon refreshes. An update from an older installer may still redraw icons once.
